meaning:
Jearim = "forests"
a hill on the northern boundary of Judah
Another name of ke.sa.lon (כְּסָלוֹן "Chesalon" H3693)

elsewhere.note: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim (also called Chesalon) on the north, and went down…
